document type it can encounter. That refusal is deliberate: plan §4.2 requires a written
retention rule from a licensed Virginia attorney BEFORE any identity document is copied
forward. Over-retention of identity documents is its own liability.

template extracts nothing. They are not advice and not a recommendation.
Replace every 'basis' string with counsel's actual stated reasoning.
